subject: AstraNova private deployment - appliance staging, VPC peering & certification plan
messages:
From: Michael Jensen <michael.jensen@astranova.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@astranova.com
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: AstraNova private deployment - initial staging info

Hi Priyom / Camila,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As promised, I'm sending the first batch of artifacts to get our VPC peering and on-prem appliance staging scheduled. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm which subnets we should reserve for the appliance front-facing interface vs. the backend KV/cache traffic.
- Walk through your cert expectations (SANs, OCSP/CRL) for the appliance mTLS certs.
- Validate the attached network diagram and VLAN mapping, flag any conflicts with our existing infra.

Attachments: network-diagram-astranova.png, vlan-mapping-astranova.xlsx, onprem-manifest-astranova.pdf

Proposed timeline:
- Week of June 20: Peering config review + cert requirements
- Week of June 27: Appliance staging (1 x GPU rack) in our staging DC; smoke tests third week

Can we get a 45-min slot next week to run the peering checklist? I can share the jump host details during the call.

Thanks,
Michael Jensen
Director, Infrastructure
AstraNova, Inc.

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Jensen <michael.jensen@astranova.com>, camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 12:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AstraNova private deployment - initial staging info

Michael — thanks for the artifacts. I pulled the manifests and VLAN sheet; a few quick notes before we meet: 

1) Subnet split: we'll want a /28 for the appliance front-end (public-facing endpoint) and a separate /26 for backend KV/cache replication; that keeps KV traffic off the customer-facing VLAN. Camila — can you confirm appliance NIC mapping for the model-serving interfaces?

2) Certificates: we support either a single SAN cert for the appliance (primary FQDN + cluster internal names) or individual node certs. For staging, a SAN cert is quicker; for prod we recommend node certs rotated by your KMS. We require OCSP stapling enabled; CRL-only is acceptable if you have an internal CRL distribution point.

3) Firewall rules: we'll need TCP 443 inbound on the peered subnet and TCP 10250/10251 between appliance nodes for orchestration. Please confirm your egress policies so we can validate health-check callbacks.

I booked a provisional 45-min review: https://calendly.com/priyom-das/astranova-peering-review — slot on Mon 20th 10:00 AM PT. If that doesn't work ping me and we'll adjust.

I'll have an internal pre-check with Grace to validate our cert lifecycle and staging host access.

Best,
Priyom Das
Implementation Manager, Redwood Inference

From: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Michael Jensen <michael.jensen@astranova.com>
Cc: olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 08:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AstraNova private deployment - initial staging info

Adding a few details from the appliance side:

- NIC mapping: eth0 (mgmt + metrics), eth1 (front-end API), eth2 (KV/backend). We'll supply an interface manifest as part of the installer.
- Disk layout: NVMe for model cache (/var/cache/model), separate mirrored storage for logs. Please confirm any retention limits you need on logs before we turn on debug level for the smoke tests.
- Jump host: prefer ephemeral SSH certs from your SSO; we'll accept key-based if you cannot issue certs quickly.

@Olga: can you pick up the cert requirements doc and draft the minimal SANs we should request for staging? We'll align on prod rotation in a separate thread.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Michael Jensen <michael.jensen@astranova.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AstraNova private deployment - initial staging info

On Fri, Jun 15, 2028 at 08:11 AM camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Adding a few details from the appliance side:
> 
> - NIC mapping: eth0 (mgmt + metrics), eth1 (front-end API), eth2 (KV/backend).

Thanks Camila — draft SAN layout below (staging):

- staging-astranova-redwood.priv.example.com (primary)
- staging-node-01.staging.local
- staging-node-02.staging.local

For prod we will recommend:
- *.astranova.redwood.priv
- node-<id>.astranova.redwood.priv

OCSP: required. We'll provide CSR template and a small script to submit/renew against your KMS (AWS ACM or self-hosted Vault).

Network checks: Priyom — please confirm if AstraNova needs a static route for the backend /26 or if BGP will be used for the peering. If BGP, we need ASNs and MD5 secret if you require session protection.

I'll attach the CSR template to the follow-up.

— Olga
Security & Integrations, Redwood Inference

From: Michael Jensen <michael.jensen@astranova.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@astranova.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jun 2028 10:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AstraNova private deployment - initial staging info

Thanks team — quick clarifications after internal ops call:

- We will do BGP peering for backend traffic. ASN: 64512. We will not require MD5.
- For the front-end subnet we prefer static route advertisement (we keep those IPs assigned to our load balancer).
- We can provide ephemeral SSH certs via our SSO provider for the jump host — Sarah (cc'd) will coordinate.

I'm confirming the staging rack availability for week of 27th and will upload the appliance manifest (rack RU allocation).

Michael

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Jensen <michael.jensen@astranova.com>, camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2028 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AstraNova private deployment - initial staging info

Great — thanks for the BGP + ASN details. Action items we captured during our review (assigning owners):

- Priyom: create peering config template and attendant firewall rules (PRD: PR-astro-0728) — target 2028-06-23 for draft.
- Camila: prepare appliance installer manifest and RU map; include SSH cert acceptance method — target 2028-06-24.
- Olga: CSR template + OCSP instructions (draft) — target 2028-06-22.
- Grace: run internal cert rotation and staging-smoke checklist against the manifest — target 2028-06-26.

I've uploaded a working folder with artifacts and a short test plan: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/astranova-private-deploy-2028

Next: I'll open a Jira ticket (OPS-9812) to track the peering cutover and link the test results. If everyone is aligned, I'll convert the provisional Calendly slot into a confirmed invite for Tue 27 Jun 10:00 AM PT.

Thanks team — looking forward to the staging window.

Priyom Das
Implementation Manager, Redwood Inference
